messages:
Maya (AE): Heads up  BigBank procurement just emailed asking for the minimal compliance artifacts to start the Dedicated POC: SOC 2 confirmation, pen-test attestation, sanitized staging network diagram, KMS/key flow example, and a short SOW line for Dedicated pricing. They said PDFs preferred.
Omar (Security): We can provide a SOC2 cover note + auditor name and effective date (no full report), a pen-test attestation letter signed by our vendor, and an ISO scope excerpt. Raw vuln findings require an NDA.
Linh (Solutions Eng): Ill build a "POC compliance bundle" zip. Should we replace internal hostnames/IPs with placeholders and stamp docs as "redacted for third-party"?
Omar (Security): Yes replace hostnames/IPs with placeholders. Pen-test letter must state test date, scope (redacted), vendor sig, and a remediation statement.
Carlos (Infra): For Dedicated staging in their VPC + KMS integration estimate: 4 business days after order for standard flow. If they want a dedicated subnet + direct-connect it's longer. I can supply an anonymized network diagram and a sample systemd unit for the inference service.
Maya (AE): Procurement deadline is EOD +4 business days. They need something they can attach to their procurement packet now. Can we hit EOD +3?
Omar (Security): Security + Legal sign-off typically 48-72 hours for attestation letters. If Linh can prep redactions today, we can likely hit EOD +3. Need approval to include last pen-test date (we usually include it).
Maya (AE): Include the last test date. Also they asked if Dedicated has a price uplift and lead time  give them a short bullet they can paste into the SOW.
Linh (Solutions Eng): Draft checklist I'm starting:
  - soc2-cover-note.pdf (one-page)
  - pen-test-attestation.pdf (signed)
  - iso-scope-excerpt.pdf
  - staging-network-diagram.png/.svg (hosts redacted)
  - kms-keyflow.png (customer key separation annotated)
  - staging-creds-template.md (example: `username: redwood-staging, key: <ROTATED_PLACEHOLDER>` )
  - dedicated-pricing-faq.md (lead time + price delta)
ETA: 48 hours to assemble before Security review.
legal-bot: Legal review queued for document set: ticket #LB-8892. Turnaround: ~24h after upload.
Carlos (Infra): I'll queue a staging-provision job. deploy-bot: Job #4982 queued: create-poc-staging (owner: Carlos). ETA ~5h.
deploy-bot: Job #4982 started: create-poc-staging. Logs will appear in /var/log/deploys/4982.log.
Linh (Solutions Eng): Upload target (internal presigned): https://presigned.s3.redwood.internal/bigbank/poc-1745126789/pack.zip (will rotate keys before share).
Omar (Security): Quick redaction rules for Linh: remove IPs, replace hostnames with <redacted-host>, remove AWS account IDs, keep architecture semantics. Pen-test raw report: only on NDA request.
Maya (AE): OK great. I'll update BigBank procurement: target EOD +3, will send presigned link when ready. Tagging @legal if manual signature needed.
Linh (Solutions Eng): Will ping when upload complete and include a tiny FAQ blurb re: Dedicated pricing and timeline.
Omar (Security): Once uploaded I'll review and add security stamp.
Maya (AE): Thanks team  please flag any blockers ASAP.
file_note: POC compliance pack coordination for BigBank Dedicated trial; contains short Slack-style thread and metadata.
